## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT create a new app — existing IVX Holdings project at `/home/user/rork-app`
- App is **Expo Go (React Native)**, NOT Swift
- User demands honesty — do NOT claim VERIFIED without production proof
- User communicates in both English and Spanish
- `github_commit_multi_file` API: `action` + `confirm: true` + `confirmText` at TOP LEVEL, `files` + `commitMessage` inside `input`; `confirmText` must be `"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"`; file content can be `gzip-base64` encoded via `contentEncoding` field; `files` is an ARRAY of `{path, content, contentEncoding}` objects

- APK upload: `curl -F "file=@path" https://tmpfiles.org/api/v1/upload` (temporary ~1hr link)
- **Rate limiting**: Production API returns HTTP 429 when firing too many requests in rapid succession — must add `sleep 1-2` between API calls in batch tests
- Background processes: `nohup python3 script.py > /tmp/output.txt 2>&1 &` but results files must be in accessible paths; check with `ps aux | grep script`
- `nohup` background scripts can exceed 60s timeout but interactive bash commands cannot — write long tests to files and run in background
